LOOK: The Buhang Flyover in Jaro, Iloilo City is temporarily closed on Friday, January 30, as workers adjust the vertical signage at the entrance and exit points, causing heavy traffic for much of the morning.

Starting next week, it will be closed for repairs ordered by DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon, who personally inspected the damage, including cement falling from its underside and emerging cracks.

📷: Tara Yap | MB

data.text:
TEMPORARY ROAD CLOSURE SA EDSA

Pansamantalang isasara ang ilang kalsada sa kahabaan ng North EDSA hanggang West Avenue simula February 1  para magbigay-daan sa installation ng MRT-7 turnback steel box girders o malalaking bakal.

Inanunsyo ito ng VPS Steel Structure Corporation sa MMDA ngayong Biyernes, Jan. 30.

Isasara ang North EDSA (sa pagitan ng Landmark–Trinoma at Unified Grand Central Station) simula February 1 hanggang May 19, 10 p.m.- 4 a.m.

Hindi rin muna magagamit ng mga motorista ang West Avenue/EDSA na pansamatalang isasara mula March 24 hanggang April 29, sa kaparehong oras.

📸: VPS Steel Structure Corporation/MMDA

data.text:
TUTOL SA CARPOOLING SA EDSA  BUSWAY

Hindi sang-ayon ang Department of Transportation (DOTr) sa mungkahing payagan ang carpooling sa EDSA Busway.

Ayon kay Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez, idinesenyo ang busway para magbigay ng mabilis na serbisyo para sa mga pasahero ng bus na umaabot sa 300,000 kada araw.

"Any move to open this lane to private vehicles, even under the guise of carpooling, will inevitably slow down bus operations and defeat the very purpose for which the busway was created," saad ni Lopez.

"We appreciate the efforts of MMDA General Manager Nicolas Torre III to look for solutions to traffic congestion in the Metro, but the President’s directives are clear: government transport policy must be commuter-focused and pro–mass transit, not car-centric," dagdag niya.
